classificationDefinitions.ENFORCED: an executable artefact proves it (test, verifier script, migration, policy or machine-checked contract match) and, where a boundary is declared, a real call site invokes it
classificationDefinitions.DECLARED: a module, document or contract mentions it, but nothing executable proves it
classificationDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED: implementation and tests exist, but the declared boundary patterns match nothing — the capability protects nothing yet

areas.area: Infrastructure fabric invariants are statically verified
areas.requirement: Provider roots/modules, secret references, remote state, pinning, tags, namespaces, quotas, network policy, sandbox and neutrality constraints are checked.

areas.area: Cloud-touching waves are credential-gated and read-only by default
areas.requirement: Preflight reports missing secret names without values, bootstrap remains dry, and deployment claims remain blocked without credentials.

areas.area: Region records and tenant-data residency fail closed
areas.requirement: Regions declare jurisdiction/sovereignty, worker/edge regions cannot hold tenant data, and referenced regions exist in the inventory.

areas.area: Infrastructure sandbox and supply-chain boundaries are contained
areas.requirement: Sandbox networking is default-deny, time-boxed, lowest priority, credential-free and isolated from runtime namespaces; provider versions are pinned.

areas.area: Infrastructure health, SLO, incident, cost, secrets and change records are represented
areas.requirement: Cloud governance records cover health, SLO/error budgets, alerts/incidents/runbooks, cost, secrets, break-glass, policy, deployments, migration, kill switches and change approvals.

areas.area: Infrastructure remains provider-neutral and does not duplicate platform engines
areas.requirement: The fabric hosts owned capabilities without replacing identity, authorization, automation, analytics or twin engines, and optional layers remain non-critical.

areas.area: Live planetary placement, fleets and recovery are operational
areas.requirement: Approved credentials, deployed regions/edge/fleets, real telemetry, failover and recovery evidence prove operational planetary infrastructure.

limitations: Classification measures the presence of executable evidence, not the correctness or completeness of that evidence.
A DECLARED area is unfinished work, never a false claim — it is reported as such.
An IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED area has a tested implementation that no boundary calls; it is reported, never counted as enforcement.
Evidence patterns are declared per phase in architecture/phase-acceptance/phase-<id>-*.json and must be reviewed when a phase is re-audited.
